verdict.rationale: PayPal's agent toolkit and MCP server document agent-callable tools for `create_product` and for creating subscription plans, which give a product plus recurring pricing. Payment Links are documented only as a no-code dashboard feature, so an agent cannot evidently create one via the API. Invoices and orders offer shareable payment URLs, but they are a different feature and are not credited here. Missing for 10: an API or agent tool for creating Payment Links, a standalone one-time price object, and evidence of the full product→price→link flow working in one agent session.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new product, price, and payment link via the API in a single session

citations.quote: create_product: Create a new product in the PayPal catalog.
